//targetDates: The week of July 6, 2026 (Mon-Sat). Any of these opening up triggers auto-book. Override per-run with the TARGET_DATES var/input for the far-out test booking.
//login: The booking wizard requires being signed in (to select the pet). Credentials come from the BOOKING_EMAIL / BOOKING_PASSWORD secrets; this section only holds non-secret selectors. Empty = use the built-in generic login detection.
//preSteps: Ordered clicks that walk the wizard from the landing page to the calendar. Best-effort: a step that isn't found is skipped, not fatal. Derived from the real booking screenshots.
//selectors: Optional overrides for calendar/time/waiver/payment controls. Empty = built-in heuristic.
//booking: Service to pick + form fields. PII (CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PHONE, PET_NAME) comes from env/secrets.

booking.service: d4) Doodle/Curly Large Breed Full Groom 41-70 lbs
